content:
Although Labor Day deals have ended, Amazon is still holding onto AirPods Pro 3 holiday discounts at $50 off, alongside the return of the AirTag 2 all-time low at $20 each. But today's 9to5Toys Lunch Break focus is the first discount on the all-new M5 Max Mac Studio launching this month, alongside ongoing M6 Mac mini deals. Plus, the most affordable Apple Studio Display of 2026 is back at its all-time low with $100 off, while the base 15-inch M5 MacBook Air is also at its best price in months with $150 off. For more deals, see below.

Labor Day may be over, but if you're quick, you can still catch the holiday discount on AirPods Pro 3.

The official Labor Day deals have wrapped up, but Amazon is still maintaining the holiday discount on AirPods Pro 3 at $50 off — we wouldn't expect this deal to stick around long.

As of writing, Amazon has the latest Apple AirPods Pro 3 on sale for $199 with free shipping.

Down from $249 with $50 off the regular price, it's one of the best post-Labor Day markdowns worth watching right now.

  • AirPods Max 2 for $449 (originally $549)
  • AirPods Pro 3 for $199 (originally $249)
  • AirPods 4 for $99 (originally $129)

Amazon relaunches the AirTag 2 holiday all-time low at $20 each

After briefly snapping back to MSRP at the tail end of the Labor Day sale, Amazon has relaunched the 2026 AirTag 2 all-time low starting at $20 each.

While Amazon held onto the AirPods Pro 3 Labor Day markdown through this morning, the special all-time low on the four-pack of Apple AirTag 2 unsurprisingly bounced back to MSRP.

But Amazon decided to bring back this holiday deal this morning, with the four-pack at $79.99 shipped. That's nearly 20% off the regular $99 price tag, marking the strong return of the best offer we've tracked on Apple's latest AirTags.

The single pack is now $24 with free shipping for Prime members, also marking the best price we've tracked on a single unit.

  • AirTag 2 for $24 (originally $29) — matching the all-time low
  • AirTag 2 four-pack for $80 (originally $99) — new all-time low

First discount on the all-new Apple M5 Max Mac Studio ahead of its launch this month

Beyond the ongoing pre-order deals on the new M6 and M5 Pro Mac minis, we're also tracking the first discount on Apple's all-new M5 Max Mac Studio ahead of its launch this month.

Amazon has the 2026 M5 Max Mac Studio on sale right now for $2,449.99 with free shipping.

Originally priced at $2,499, Amazon is giving you a chance to grab it at a pre-order price before the official launch, saving you nearly $50.

  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/256GB for $880 (originally $899)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 16GB/512GB for $1,070 (originally $1,099)
  • 2026 Mac mini M6 24GB/512GB for $1,270 (originally $1,299)
  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB for $1,670 (originally $1,699)
  • 2026 Mac Studio M5 Max 36GB/512GB for $2,450 (originally $2,499)

Set to launch on September 22 alongside the new Mac mini lineup, here's the "new generation of power" — Apple's Mac Studio model equipped with the latest M5 Max chip.

Today's discounted configuration is the base, entry-level model, featuring an 18-core/32-core processor, 36GB of RAM, and 512GB of built-in storage.

While $49 off isn't a massive discount at this price point, it's still a deal on a brand-new Mac that hasn't officially launched yet — if you're still considering a pre-order but don't want to pay full price through Apple, you might as well save a bit at Amazon.

The most affordable Apple Studio Display of 2026 returns to its Amazon all-time low with $100 off

Last week's Labor Day deals saw Amazon set multiple all-time lows across Apple's latest 2026 Studio Display lineup, but mostly on higher-end configurations. Today Amazon has finally covered the base model, returning to the all-time low at $100 off the regular price.

Amazon has the 2026 Apple Studio Display with standard glass and a tilt-adjustable stand on sale for $1,499 with free shipping.

This model with the tilt-adjustable stand normally runs $1,599 at Apple and other retailers, and today's deal takes $100 off, making it the best price we've found.

This price also marks the return of the Amazon all-time low. The model briefly hit $1,499 a few times early in its launch, but has mostly hovered around the $1,550 mark since.

While this isn't necessarily the best deal on a monitor out there, if you're looking to upgrade to Apple's 2026 display technology, today marks the lowest entry price we've tracked.

Apple's most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air hits its best price in months with $150 off

Amazon is currently offering the base 15-inch M5 MacBook Air at its best price in months, with the Midnight Black version going for $150 off the regular price.

Amazon has the 15-inch M5 MacBook Air with 16GB of RAM and 512GB of storage on sale for $1,349 with free shipping. Right now only the Midnight Black variant has dropped to this price, which usually means the deal won't last long.

This configuration, originally priced at $1,499, is $150 cheaper than Apple and other authorized resellers.

Since the price increase, this configuration — the most affordable 15-inch M5 MacBook Air — has been the lowest price we've tracked. While it hasn't returned to former pricing levels, it's still the best deal on the more affordable configurations in this lineup in months.

As of now, even the official Apple Certified Refurbished store has no MacBook Air models in stock.

Sony launches updated version of "fan favorite 1000XM4" headphones, the new XM4C is even more affordable

Update: The new WH-1000XM4C wireless noise-cancelling headphones are now on sale at Sony and Amazon for $299.99. Shipping is expected between September 23 and October 1.

Today's accessory and charging deals:

  • Samsung's latest ViewFinity S7 4K UHD workstation monitor drops to all-time low of $200
  • nuPhy Air75 wireless Mac mechanical keyboard, originally $150, now just $70 with Labor Day discount
  • Mice can be cheap — Acer's six-button adjustable DPI model is now just $10
  • This magnetic M.2 NVMe enclosure doubles as a lightweight hub with SD/TF card readers, 100W PD, and more — now just $33
  • Beats woven USB-C short cable keeps things tidy for just $8 with Prime shipping
  • Lexar mini 1TB SSD + USB-C hub bundle drops to post-increase low with $100 off, one of the best Labor Day deals

M6 Mac mini pre-order deals now live at Amazon, shipping this month

The all-new M6 Mac mini and M5 Pro models are getting closer to launch. If you're still thinking about pre-ordering, consider picking up a new $9 Apple Polishing Cloth and checking out Amazon's pre-order deals on the new Mac mini.

We've covered these deals across multiple posts, so we're consolidating them here for easy reference if you're still considering a pre-order:

  • 2026 Mac mini M5 Pro 24GB/512GB for $1,669 (originally $1,699)

Among the configurations currently on sale at Amazon, only the 24GB M6 model isn't getting any discount. While the savings aren't huge, we're talking about brand-new products Apple hasn't officially launched yet. If you plan to pre-order without a trade-in, the money saved can go toward gas, coffee, or grabbing those new polishing cloths while supplies last.

Be sure to check out Amazon and Best Buy for the big Labor Day deals this week, and stay tuned for the latest on Apple's new M6 and M5 Pro launches:

Apple's 2026 AirPods Max 2 sees $100 off during Labor Day weekend

As part of the major Labor Day weekend deals, combined with the ongoing $50 discount on AirPods Pro 3, Amazon is now offering $100 off nearly every color of the latest AirPods Max 2.

Amazon just dropped the price of the Apple 2026 AirPods Max 2 to $449 and up with free shipping. That's $100 off the regular $549 price.

At the time of writing, all colors except orange have dropped to this price (or are within $1 of it).

  • AirPods 4 Amazon deal at $79 (originally $129)

Most colors had snapped back to near MSRP before the major Labor Day deals kicked off, but we're finally seeing holiday discounts again. While it's not the lowest price we've tracked, today's deal is only $20 below the August summer markdown and matches the best offers outside of the major Prime Day in June.

Apple Max 2 launched earlier with the same smart case, exterior, and USB-C charging port as the previous generation, but features an H2 chip with active noise cancellation "1.5x better than the previous generation," along with new high dynamic range amplifiers, live translation, conversation awareness, and transparency mode.
